metadata.title: Tesla’s Electric Semi Could Win From High Diesel Prices<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla’s Electric Semi Could Win From High Diesel Prices
Electric, autonomously driven big rigs are one solution to the shipping industry’s current diesel problem. That’s an opportunity for Tesla.
